card.name: Adverbs like again, soon, more
card.fires_on: Short adverbs and particles such as again, more, soon, finally, out, returned, placed right after a subject or verb in general web prose. They often mark repetition or timing.

modes.label: Repetition words
modes.description: Again or more signalling something happening a further time.
modes.example: It is found<< again>> in a tall, a liaison form

modes.label: Time adverbs
modes.description: Soon or finally placed before a verb to mark when something happens.
modes.example: they will<< soon>> rot if exposed to rain

modes.label: Particles after verbs
modes.description: Out, of or returned following a subject or verb in ordinary narrative.
modes.example: The rest<< of>> us had to pay for all of this

card.plain: It fires on small adverbs like again, soon and more that mark repetition or timing in everyday prose.
